facts.label: Said he would
facts.sub: Para contar uma promessa, use said (that) + sujeito + would + verbo base: He said he would call me. She said they would send a text.

facts.label: Would
facts.sub: Use said + would para contar uma promessa ou plano: He said he would call me. Would é o passado de will. Ele serve para todas as pessoas: I, you, he, she, we, they.

facts.label: Promessas
facts.sub: Lojas, técnicos e amigos fazem promessas: I will call you. Para contar depois, mude: He said he would call me. Use said that ou apenas said. That é opcional.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Will changes to would in reported speech.
We say “He said he will call” about last week.
items.why: We say He said he would call.

items.s: “She said they would send a text” is correct.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Will changes to would in reported speech. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “He said he will call” about last week. → Falso (We say He said he would call.)
“She said they would send a text” is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A phone store · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold afternoon in the city of Halifax. Noah walks into a small phone store near the harbor. He left his phone there a week ago. The technician promised to call him. Isla works at the front desk. She smiles and says hello.
“Hi, Noah! Are you here about your phone?” says Isla. “Yes. The technician said he would call me on Tuesday.” says Noah. “Oh. He told me he would fix it by Wednesday.” says Isla.

items.why: Com she, o verbo leva -s: fixes.
Com we, a forma base: promise.

She ___ every day. → fixes
He is ___ now. → ordering
We ___ every day. → promise

pages.title: Laboratório de sons · o som
pages.what: Would soa “uód”, mas na fala fica curto: he’d call soa “hid cól”. Na frase He said he would call, o would quase some.
pages.how: Diga he said he would com o would bem curto.
pages.tip: Compare would e will: would /uód/, will /uíl/.

solo: Modele, peça repetição, depois uso livre.
group: Foco: would e ’d. Diga he said he would com o would bem curto.
Coro, depois um a um; ouça sem corrigir tudo.
extra90: Cada aluno grava um áudio de 10 segundos e compara com o modelo.

pages.instruction: Escolha a forma que resolve a situação; explique o erro comum.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Escolha a frase mais natural. → He said he would call me.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → She said she would help.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → He said he would call me.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → She told me that she would come.
